content_data.project_title: Automated Content Pipeline Migration to Cloud-Native Architecture
content_data.project_description: Migration of legacy on-premises media processing workflows to a containerized, cloud-native infrastructure to improve scalability and reduce operational costs. This initiative will modernize our automation stack while maintaining backward compatibility with existing broadcast systems.
content_data.timeline: 14 months with Phase 1: Infrastructure Setup (months 1-4), Phase 2: Migration and Testing (months 5-10), Phase 3: Optimization and Handoff (months 11-14)
objectives: Migrate 80% of media processing workflows from on-premises to cloud infrastructure
Establish CI/CD pipelines for continuous deployment of workflow updates
deliverables: Containerized microservices architecture for media processing workflows
Performance monitoring dashboards and alerting systems
Comprehensive API documentation and integration guides
Automated testing framework with 85% code coverage
Kubernetes cluster configuration with auto-scaling policies
resources_needed: 1 QA engineer for testing and validation
3 full-time backend engineers for development and migration
External consultant for legacy system knowledge transfer (3 months)
